payload.description:
High-quality material: This stylish paper towel holder, made of natural, high-quality beech wood, is sturdy, durable, and easy to clean. Thanks to its elegant grain, it’s a real eye-catcher in your kitchen. This paper towel holder lets you combine style and functionality in your kitchen.

Unique design: The simple and practical design of the kitchen roll holder makes your kitchen worktop look elegant and modern and easy to install. Small balls can prevent paper towels from being scattered.

Perfect size: 31 cm x 13 cm. The paper towel holder is suitable for most standard and large rolls. Ideal for use in kitchens, half-bathrooms, and anywhere with limited storage space.

Non-slip design: The bottom of the paper towel holder is equipped with 4 non-slip pads; it is sturdy and stable and can be easily placed on the table.
